title: Transfer Barter
recipient_hint: Identifier of who will receive the money. Format @user@node. E.g. @maria@localhost or @carlos@node2.org. If they are on your same node, just @maria.
amount_hint: Amount of Barter units to send. Accepts decimals (cents). E.g. 1.50 to send one Barter and fifty cents.
reference_hint: Note so the recipient knows the reason for the payment. Appears in both histories.
error_invalid_amount: Invalid amount. Must be a positive number (e.g. 1.50)

wallet.title: My Wallet
wallet.help_desc: This is your personal wallet. Here you see your balance and all your transactions.
wallet.help_debit_desc: Transactions where you sent {{currency}}. They appear in network with a negative sign.
wallet.help_credit_desc: Transactions where you received {{currency}}. They appear in green with a positive sign.
wallet.help_balance_desc: It is the difference between income and expenses. If positive, they owe you. If negative, you owe.
wallet.help_filter_desc: Use the buttons to view transactions from the last 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, 3 months, or all.
wallet.help_org_accounts_desc: To view the wallet of an organization or department, go to that entity from the menu. Each has its own internal wallet.
wallet.period_balance_desc: The period balance shows income minus outgoing in the selected range.
wallet.real_balance_desc: The real balance is the total accumulated balance of the account.

pay.balance_debt: debt with the community (you must contribute)
pay.balance_credit: in favor of the community (you can receive)
pay.name: Name
pay.error_paid: This payment has already been made
pay.error_read_qr: Could not read the QR code
pay.warn_exceeds_credit: This payment would take you to {{after}} TQ, below your community credit limit ({{limit}} TQ). You must contribute to the community (goods or work) to be able to pay again.
pay.warn_exceeds_debit: This payment would take you to {{after}} TQ, above your debit limit ({{limit}} TQ). You must receive from the community to be able to pay again.
pay.warn_near_credit: Attention: after this payment you would be at {{pct}}% of your community credit limit ({{limit}} TQ).
pay.warn_near_debit: Attention: after this payment you would be at {{pct}}% of your debit limit ({{limit}} TQ).

payments.title: Payments
payments.help_what: A transfer of balance from your account to the account of another person or organization within the exchange network. The balance is deducted from your account and added to the recipient's.
payments.help_purpose: To trade within the network: buy products, pay for services, settle debts, etc. Everything is recorded in both parties' history.
payments.help_qr: QR: Generate a QR code for someone to pay you, or scan another person's QR to pay them. The other person scans it with their phone camera or uploads a photo of the QR.
payments.help_nfc: NFC: Payment with a physical NFC card. The merchant reads the customer's card with an NFC reader connected to an ESP32 terminal.
payments.help_manual: Manual: Direct transfer by entering the recipient's ID (UUID). Useful when there is no QR or NFC.
payments.help_amount: It is the amount of balance transferred. It is measured in the node's local currency. It can be fixed (you define it when generating the QR) or free (the payer decides how much).
payments.help_recipient: The recipient's account. In QR it comes inside the code. In NFC it is obtained from the card UID. In manual you must enter their ID (UUID).
payments.help_note_label: What is the note / label / reference:
payments.help_note: An optional text describing the reason for the payment (e.g: "Bread purchase"). Appears in both histories so they remember what the payment was for.
payments.error_camera_denied: Camera permission denied. Go to the browser settings, find the permissions for this page and allow camera access.
payments.error_no_camera: No camera found on this device. Use "Upload QR image" instead.
payments.error_scanner_init: Error initializing the scanner. Reload the page and try again.
payments.error_camera_generic: Could not access the camera: {{msg}}. Check permissions or use upload image.
payments.error_invalid_qr: Invalid QR or could not be read
payments.error_no_qr_found: No QR code found in the image
payments.qr_gen_desc: Generate a QR code for someone to pay you. If you specify an amount, the QR will be to pay exactly that amount. If you leave it empty, the payer decides the amount.
payments.display_name_hint: How you want the payer to see you. Appears next to the QR. E.g: "Juan Perez" or "Ferreteria Don Jose".
payments.amount_fixed_hint: How much they should pay you. If you leave it empty, the payer decides the amount when scanning. E.g: 500 for a fixed payment of 500.
payments.label_hint: A short text describing the reason for the payment. Appears in both histories. E.g: "Product payment" or "January fee".
payments.scan_desc: Scan the QR code of the person who will receive the payment. You can use the camera or upload a QR image.
payments.enter_amount_hint: How much balance you want to send to the recipient. Must be greater than 0. E.g: 500 to pay 500 units.
payments.nfc_desc: Enter the UID of the user's NFC card. In production, this field is filled automatically when the card is brought near the NFC reader connected to the ESP32 terminal.
payments.nfc_uid_hint: The unique identifier of the customer's NFC card. In production it is read automatically when the card is brought near the reader. E.g: 04A3B2C1.
payments.nfc_external_note: Card from another node - will be queried via federation
payments.manual_desc: Direct transfer to another user. You need their ID (UUID). The sender is you (obtained from your session).
payments.manual_id_hint: The unique identifier (UUID) of the account that will receive the payment. You can ask the recipient for it. E.g: a14dd44f-8da1-4bf7-8ad6-762a9d10d562.
payments.manual_amount_hint: How much balance you want to send. Must be greater than 0 and not exceed your credit limit. E.g: 500 to send 500 units.
payments.manual_ref_hint: A brief note describing the reason for the payment. Appears in both histories. E.g: "Product payment" or "Week 3 debt".

help_what: It is the direct sending of Barter units from your account to another user's account on the federated network. It is the basic operation of the system: one person delivers value to another.
help_purpose: To pay another person for a good, service or favor, settle a debt, gift Barter units, or carry out any economic exchange between two participants on the network.
help_recipient: Any registered user on the federated network. They are identified with the format @user@node (e.g.: @maria@localhost). If the person is on your same node, @user is enough. You cannot transfer to yourself.
help_amount: It is the quantity of Barter units you are going to send. 1 TQ equals 1 kWh of energy. The amount is always a positive integer (e.g.: 50, 100, 250).
help_note: It is an optional text that accompanies the transfer so the recipient knows the reason. It appears in the history of both parties.
help_tax: The system can apply a small tax (commission) on each transfer. This tax is deducted from the amount the recipient receives and is sent to the node or community account. The sender does not pay extra: they send the indicated amount and the recipient receives that amount minus the tax. The percentage is defined by the node configuration.
help_limits_label: What are the credit and debit limits:
help_limits: The system allows your balance to be negative (credit) or positive (debit). Credit means you owe Barter units to the community (negative balance). Debit means the community owes you (positive balance). There is a maximum credit limit defined by the node to prevent abuse.
help_zero_sum_label: Important - The system sums to zero:
help_zero_sum: For each transfer, what leaves one account enters another. No money is created from nothing nor does it disappear: the total of all balances on the network is always zero.
